theme: How much lying changes the outcome
title: Smallest Lying Coalition
strategies: full-electorate baseline: every voter joins the coalition and bullet-votes the target (checker's own B)
single-pass recipe: bury the CURRENT sincere winner behind the target, add voters in input order until the rule flips -- ignores that a two-round rule's runner-up can change identity mid-manipulation

rule-aware constructive search: try every full ballot template (which rival(s) get buried in which slot) crossed with principled voter-selection orders, re-simulating the actual rule to certify the smallest coalition directly -- exploits which candidate should be kept alive as a beatable runoff opponent instead of just maximizing the target's own score
